tunables.label: n8n Port
tunables.description: Port on which n8n listens inside the container.
tunables.troubleshooting: Must match the published container port.

tunables.label: n8n Host
tunables.description: Host address on which n8n listens.
tunables.troubleshooting: Must be 0.0.0.0 in Docker so container port forwarding works.

tunables.label: Node Environment
tunables.troubleshooting: Keep at production for optimal performance and security.

tunables.label: Webhook URL
tunables.description: Public URL used for webhooks and trigger callbacks when running behind a reverse proxy.
tunables.troubleshooting: Required when n8n is deployed behind a reverse proxy or SSL terminator so webhook links are registered with external services using HTTPS.

tunables.label: Enforce Settings File Permissions
tunables.description: Enforce strict file permissions (0600) on n8n config/encryption key files.
tunables.troubleshooting: Set to false only if mounting storage on filesystems (e.g. NTFS / CIFS) that do not support POSIX permission modes.

tunables.label: Encryption Key
tunables.description: Key used to encrypt credentials stored in the database.
tunables.troubleshooting: If unset, n8n auto-generates a key in the persistent volume (~/.n8n/config). Back up this key; if lost, credentials cannot be decrypted.

tunables.label: Generic Timezone
tunables.description: Default timezone used in workflow Cron / Schedule triggers.
tunables.troubleshooting: Use standard IANA timezone name (e.g. UTC, Asia/Jakarta).

tunables.label: System Timezone
tunables.description: System timezone for the container process.
tunables.troubleshooting: Set to the desired timezone to ensure log timestamps align with your local time.

tunables.label: Database Type
tunables.troubleshooting: Defaults to embedded SQLite in ~/.n8n. Set to postgresdb for multi-instance or high-volume queue mode.

tunables.label: PostgreSQL Host
tunables.description: Hostname or IP for PostgreSQL database when DB_TYPE=postgresdb.
tunables.troubleshooting: Ensure PostgreSQL is reachable and database is initialized before starting n8n.

tunables.label: PostgreSQL Database Name
tunables.troubleshooting: Database must exist or user must have CREATE DATABASE privilege.

tunables.label: PostgreSQL User
tunables.troubleshooting: Must have read/write/ddl permissions on the database.

tunables.label: PostgreSQL Password
tunables.troubleshooting: Provide password securely via environment variable or secret.

tunables.label: Editor Base URL
tunables.description: Base URL where the n8n frontend editor is hosted.
tunables.troubleshooting: Used for generating email invite links and external redirects.

tunables.label: Diagnostics Enabled
tunables.description: Whether anonymous telemetry and usage diagnostics are sent to n8n.
tunables.troubleshooting: Set to false to run completely telemetry-free in isolated environments.

notes: n8n runs as non-root user (node, UID 1000, GID 1000). Probes are GET /healthz (liveness) and GET /healthz/readiness (readiness) on port 5678. Data is stored in /home/node/.n8n. By default uses SQLite; can be switched to PostgreSQL via DB_TYPE=postgresdb.
